evidence.name: ServerOpenTrackSignal

function_ir.summary: Server-side open-track signal handler: emits a progress event, fetches a COM object from the object at this+0x3FB8, marks and dispatches it over the network, sets an open-track flag byte, allocates an 8-byte string buffer filled with the opening track name, then appends a track-info node to a per-this linked list when the photo/free-camera mode flag (dword_7D0398) is set; otherwise it frees the temporary buffer. An optional debug log fires when a source-dev split condition holds.

operations.description: ProgressBarEventEncode(4, 38, 0, 255, low32(dbl_8AFEA0), 1) emits a progress/loading event using the global double value.
COMVTableCallVia0x60(*(this+0x3FB8)) retrieves a COM object v2 from the interface stored in this+0x3FB8.
Set byte at v2+4 to 1, marking the COM object's open-track state.
NetworkSendDispatch(v10, ((v10[0]>>8)&0x3FF)+8, v2, 1, 1, -1, 0) dispatches a network packet referencing the COM object with the buffer size derived from v10[0].
VirtualMethodDispatch(*(this+0x3FB8), v2) forwards the COM object to the stored interface dispatch.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8) allocates an 8-byte string buffer v4; when non-null initialize v4[0]=0 and v4[1]=-1.
StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(aOpening) loads the opening track name string into the reallocating string buffer.
TrackNameReader(v9, 63) reads the current track name into a 64-byte stack buffer.
sub_5665B0(v9) processes or normalizes the read track name.
Guard: dword_7C569C != 5 and StringSplitLoop(1, aDDevF119992002_1, 4833) selects the debug-log branch based on the source-dev path token and the split condition.
DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, v5) logs the buffer contents; v5 is *v4, falling back to byte_5EA438 when v4 is null.
Guard on dword_7D0398 (photo/free-camera mode flag): when non-zero append the track-info node to the linked list; when zero and the buffer exists, free it.
OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates a 12-byte linked-list node v7; when non-null initialize *v7=v4 (buffer pointer), *(v7+4)=0, *(v7+8)=0.
Guard: *(this+0x1B770) head pointer decides between appending to an existing list tail and creating the first node.
Append node: when a head exists, tail next *(*(this+0x1B774)+4)=v7; otherwise set head *(this+0x1B770) and end *(this+0x1B778) to v7; then set tail *(this+0x1B774)=v7.
Else branch (dword_7D0398 zero and v4 non-null): FreeWrapper_7bcf(*v4) frees the inner buffer, then FreeWrapper_7bcf(v4) frees the outer allocation.
Return the updated node count, or the free result on the early-out path.
